## 2. Technical Implementation Highlights

### 1. Concurrency-Safe Transaction Engine ([`server.js`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/experiments/tasks/EXP-006/server.js))
- **Deadlock-Free Lock Coordinator (`MutexCoordinator`):** Sorts account lock identifiers before acquiring asynchronous promises to guarantee strictly ordered lock acquisition.
- **Double-Entry State & Integer Cents:** All balances and transfers are computed in integer cents to eliminate IEEE 754 floating-point drift.
- **Invariants Auditor (`auditSystemInvariants`):** Validates that total liquidity remains strictly conserved ($\sum \text{balance}_a = \$100,000.00$) and no account has a negative balance ($\forall a, \text{balance}_a \ge 0$).
- **Idempotency Registry (`idempotencyStore`):** Re-checked inside the critical section to prevent replay races; duplicate keys return identical cached responses without double-debiting.

### 2. Modern Dark-Mode Dashboard ([`public/index.html`](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/experiments/tasks/EXP-006/public/index.html))
- Modern Tailwind CSS dark theme (`#080c14` canvas, slate cards, emerald accents).
- Live invariant badge with animated indicator and real-time drift metrics.
- 4 dynamic account cards with micro-interaction balance highlights.
- Interactive transfer form with auto-generated idempotency keys, optimistic UI updates, and explicit overdraft error toasts.
- Real-time settled audit ledger table displaying transaction legs, timestamps, and invariant verification tags.
